title: Spiced Veggie Ground, Apple, Celery & Cranberry Stuffed Acorn Squash

steps.text: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve each acorn squash lengthwise, trim ends, then scoop out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper; arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Quarter and core apples, then medium dice; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and small dice celery; add to the bowl with the veggies and apple.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, apple, veggie ground, and spices; cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.

When the veggie ground is done, add broth, cranberries, and sugar; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Cover and remove from heat.
To serve, divide squash halves between plates and fill with the veggie ground stuffing. Enjoy!
